name: @pipeworx/mcp-zendesk

tools.name: zd_list_tickets
tools.description: List Zendesk support tickets for the connected account, sortable by created_at, updated_at, priority, or status. Returns ticket IDs, subjects, statuses, and metadata. Supports pagination via page.

tools.name: zd_get_ticket
tools.description: Get a Zendesk ticket by ID.

tools.name: zd_search_tickets
tools.description: Search Zendesk tickets with a query string.

tools.name: zd_list_users
tools.description: List all Zendesk users (agents and end-users) in the connected account. Returns user IDs, names, emails, and roles. Supports pagination via page number.

tools.name: zd_get_user
tools.description: Get a Zendesk user by ID.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-zendesk forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the zendesk pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
